name: Chamberlain
overview: The role of a chamberlain in Scripture, as illustrated in the book of Esther, was that of a royal officer serving in the presence of the king, often entrusted with important commands and duties. The chamberlains, described as eunuchs, acted as intermediaries between the king and others, carrying out his orders as seen when they were sent to summon Queen Vashti. Their position was one of authority and close proximity to the king, emphasizing their responsibility in the administration of the royal household and enforcement of the king's will.
